capacity_gross_kwh.notes: auto-data.net: gross 31 kWh, net 28 kWh (Wikipedia's 36 kWh is not labelled gross and conflicts; Consumer Reports calls 36 a maximum-charge figure per the fact-checker).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: auto-data.net: net (usable) 28 kWh, model years 2014-2017; CHARGED calls it a 28 kWh pack. Same pack 2014-2017 (Wikipedia: facelift "remained the same in technical data").

chemistry.notes: Estimated: GUESS: auto-data says only Li-Ion; the pack was supplied by Tesla (Wikipedia), whose cells of that era were NCA, but no page states the B-Class cell type. Owner decision.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: GUESS: no page opened states the pack voltage; Tesla-supplied pack of the Model S era (about 360 V nominal). Owner decision.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: the launch article (CHARGED, US production) describes the 10 kW charger and the 28 kWh pack with no battery-warming or fast-charge feature, and the car has no DC port; Mercedes introduced navigation pre-heating later with the EQS (not shown on a page opened).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: no factory DC port: Wikipedia says Supercharging was not enabled and CHAdeMO only via aftermarket JdeMO parts; no DC rating on any page.

ac_max_kw.notes: CHARGED (US production article): "a 10 kW onboard charger".
